bio: Hewo my name is Fey Druidia! I'm a fairy or puppy girl streamer. I regularly stream with my partner Knife_ears. You may see me indifferent forms but I am a shapeshifter. I also have an alt form Seishen. We both have a catgirl that picks on us both, that's Trish. 💚💙
